system.description:
You gain +6 to [Shield]'s Physical Defense. When you enter the Climax Phase, you also gain 1 point of Fate. The Holy Sword said to lend its power to those who face tragedy. It grants the user the power to repel hardships and the blessing to carve out their fate. It takes many names and forms, appearing in the legends and knightly tales of the People of the Land.

Silver Wheel [Core Material] (500G) + Schiavona (760G) + Radiance Talisman (620G) + [Magic Catalyst 17] (280G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (930G)
